issues.extracted: Most people left before 11 pm - they were so bored.
issues.printed: Most people left before 11 pm – they were so bored.
issues.note: Printed dash is an en dash (–), extraction uses hyphen. Also this sentence and 'It was such a boring party.' are one printed line shared by boring/bored; splitting is acceptable but the shared-line split is an editorial choice.

note: All section A diagram/table words (terrible, awful, dreadful, (very) bad, OK, (very) good, marvellous, terrific, great, (very) small, (absolutely) tiny, big, huge/enormous, tired, exhausted, interesting, fascinating, surprised, astonished, (very) pleased, (absolutely) delighted, cold, freezing, nice, delicious (food only), frightened (= afraid of), terrified, hungry, starving (infml)) and all section B -ing/-ed pairs are present with correct group headings. Only defect: hyphen instead of en dash in the 'bored' example. No extra/exercise items included.
